listing.name: 4.0.0 Ship&Weapon Editor
listing.summary: A familiar editor with a few new tricks.
listing.aiSummary: Provides a tool for editing ship and weapon data with features like multipart vessel mode, screenshot mode, and multi-mod activation.

description:
A familiar editor with a few new tricks.

The source has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers.
Runs under Windows, Wine/Linux and the native Linux version.

Some of the bigger added features:

-Station/Multipart Vessel Mode
-Screenshot Mode
-Multi Mod de/activatior
-Linux installation Path support
-Damage Mode
-browse loaded mod files in most modes

Screenshots of more functions that have been added
CSV Editor Revamp

Drag & Drop

Projectile Editor

Skin Ship and Variant editor

Combined, Module Center and Station Module on Parent position adjuster

Raw File editor

Noteable bugfixes
Fixed Station Module mount function. Does not crash and works instead.
Fixed a t behing added to the first line after opening any csv editor.

Readme
Will be deployed with other additional files.

Localisation
To add your own localisation, you must adjust the text inside of the language. ini and always deploy it with the exe in a zip.

Should we have come to an agreement about the proliferation of this program through the ends of offering a translated version of this program here or on third-party websites, you have to keep the following things in mind:

-Instruct your users to override the previous language file with the one you provide in the zip.

-Do not change the name of the language.ini because the program will create its own fallback file under the correct name and use that.

-If you want to translate files like the readme.txt or changes.log file, you have to translate the filenames and provide them with the zip here to instruct your users to override the old versions of your translated files.

Download Button:

Changelog is deployed in program folder at first launch.
To make sure all files get deployed correctly purge the old program files the exe deployed in the installation folder.

Debug Download Link
https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1e0J3FvouIY3o-KdcQQFqb0wkr4BZ8kO4

This is a fork of Deathflys Ship and weapon editor version Alpha 11.

aiDescription: Offers an updated editor compatible with Windows, Wine/Linux, and native Linux. Includes new modes for stations, damage, and projectile editing, along with drag-and-drop functionality and CSV revamps.
